name: wristband
title: Wristband
description: A weekend music festival theme whose masthead is a woven satin wristband — the name and dates in condensed capitals over a diamond repeat between stitched selvedges, closed by a brass bead clasp that is the ticket link — on last-light indigo, or marquee white by day.

tokens.--font-caps: the woven capitals: band lettering, clasp, menu, headings, times, line-up names, labels and tabs
tokens.--font-body: running text, notes and the footer — a humanist sans
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the condensed capitals
tokens.--color-bg: page background: last-light indigo, or marquee white in the light scheme
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings and menu links (festoon white, or indigo ink)
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: notes, ledes, summaries, addresses, the footer and the updates link
tokens.--color-accent: links, programme times, labels, line-up roles, the current menu entry, the diamonds beside headings and focus rings
tokens.--color-rule: dividing lines and the diamond repeat above the footer
tokens.--color-surface: background of code and the search box
tokens.--color-band: the wristband's satin and every short length of it: tabs, stage and tag labels, the 404 scrap, selected text
tokens.--color-band-ink: lettering and diamonds woven into the band and its lengths; the focus ring on the band
tokens.--color-selvedge: the bound edges along the top and bottom of the band and the tabs
tokens.--color-stitch: stitched selvedges of the band and the tabs
tokens.--color-sheen: the satin highlight along the band's top edge
tokens.--color-weft: the fine weft lines across the band
tokens.--color-clasp: the brass bead clasp closing the band
tokens.--color-clasp-ink: the word on the clasp and its focus ring
tokens.--color-clasp-ridge: grip ridges at both ends of the clasp
tokens.--measure-wide: widest the band's lettering, menu, home page and footer grow
tokens.--band-pad: space above and below the band's lettering; the clasp stands this much plus a little beyond each edge
tokens.--diamond: height of the diamond repeat in the band, beside headings, under page titles and above the footer
tokens.--stitch: length of one stitch in the selvedges and in a rule in page text
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of code blocks and the search box; the band is cut square
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavier dividing lines and the menu underline
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: inside lists in page text
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under labels, dates and day headings
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-5: large gap between sections and above the reply block
